# OSPFv2 LSA (`ospfv2_lsa`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: 20 octets (fixed)
- **Notes**: [OSPF Opaque / SR, BGP MP / VPN / EVPN (P2)](../../protocols/routing-ext.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`ospfv2_lsu`](ospfv2_lsu.md) | `num_lsas` | (any other value) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ls_age` | `uint(16)` | `0` |   | Time since the LSA was originated, in seconds (keep 0 for an exact Auto checksum). |
| `options` | `flags(8)` | `0x2` |   | Optional capabilities (E, MC, N/P, L, DC, O, DN bits). |
| `ls_type` | `enum(8)` | `1` (router) | Protocol number of the next layer (see Next layer) | LSA type (Auto from the LSA body layer; 9 / 10 / 11 = opaque LSA). |
| `link_state_id` | `ipv4` | `192.0.2.1` |   | Link State ID identifying the described part of the network. |
| `advertising_router` | `ipv4` | `192.0.2.1` |   | Router ID of the router that originated the LSA. |
| `ls_sequence` | `uint(32)` | `2147483649` |   | LSA sequence number (0x80000001 = initial). |
| `ls_checksum` | `uint(16)` |   | Fletcher checksum over the header and everything after it; `ls_age` counted as zero | Fletcher checksum of the LSA without LS age (Auto). |
| `length` | `uint(16)` |   | Length of the header and payload in octets | Length of the LSA including its header, in octets (Auto). |

### `options`

| Bit | Mask | Name |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 (0x01) | `mt` |
| 1 | 2 (0x02) | `e` |
| 2 | 4 (0x04) | `mc` |
| 3 | 8 (0x08) | `np` |
| 4 | 16 (0x10) | `l` |
| 5 | 32 (0x20) | `dc` |
| 6 | 64 (0x40) | `o` |
| 7 | 128 (0x80) | `dn` |

### `ls_type`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 1 (0x01) | `router` |
| 2 (0x02) | `network` |
| 3 (0x03) | `summary_network` |
| 4 (0x04) | `summary_asbr` |
| 5 (0x05) | `as_external` |
| 7 (0x07) | `nssa_external` |
| 9 (0x09) | `link_local_opaque` |
| 10 (0x0a) | `area_opaque` |
| 11 (0x0b) | `as_opaque` |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `ls_type`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above.

| Value | Protocol | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 1 (0x01) | [`ospfv2_router_lsa`](ospfv2_router_lsa.md) |   |
| 2 (0x02) | [`ospfv2_network_lsa`](ospfv2_network_lsa.md) |   |
| 3 (0x03) | [`ospfv2_summary_lsa`](ospfv2_summary_lsa.md) |   |
| 4 (0x04) | [`ospfv2_summary_lsa`](ospfv2_summary_lsa.md) |   |
| 5 (0x05) | [`ospfv2_external_lsa`](ospfv2_external_lsa.md) |   |
| 7 (0x07) | [`ospfv2_external_lsa`](ospfv2_external_lsa.md) |   |
| 9 (0x09) – 11 (0x0b) | [`ospfv2_opaque_lsa`](ospfv2_opaque_lsa.md) | re-decodes this layer |
